sets.title: Luke ISEE Lower — Words Test 5
sets.subtitle: ISEE Lower — vocabulary, means most nearly

questions.prompt: 1. The word APPREHENSIVE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Apprehensive means anxious or worried about what might happen.

questions.prompt: 2. The word DORMANT means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Dormant means inactive for a time, like a volcano or a seed in winter.

questions.prompt: 3. The word ELABORATE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Elaborate means full of detail and carefully planned, the opposite of plain.

questions.prompt: 4. The word BRISK means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Brisk means quick and energetic.

questions.prompt: 5. The word WITTY means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Witty means clever and funny.

questions.prompt: 6. The word CONSPICUOUS means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Conspicuous means easy to see — obvious.

questions.prompt: 7. The word DEFT means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Deft means skillful and quick with the hands.

questions.prompt: 8. The word FATIGUE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Fatigue is extreme tiredness.

questions.prompt: 9. The word INNATE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Innate means present from birth — inborn, not learned.

questions.prompt: 10. The word VANQUISH means most nearly —
questions.feedback: To vanquish is to conquer or defeat completely.

questions.prompt: 11. The word CANDID means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Candid means frank and honest in speaking.

questions.prompt: 12. The word ANCIENT means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Ancient means very old.

questions.prompt: 13. The word HASTY means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Hasty means done in a rush.

questions.prompt: 14. The word PREVAIL means most nearly —
questions.feedback: To prevail is to triumph — to win out in the end.

questions.prompt: 15. The word COARSE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Coarse means rough in texture.

questions.prompt: 16. The word PERTURB means most nearly —
questions.feedback: To perturb is to disturb or unsettle.

questions.prompt: 17. The word ASSEMBLE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: To assemble is to gather together.

questions.prompt: 18. The word OBLIGE means most nearly —
questions.feedback: To oblige is to compel — to make someone do something.

questions.prompt: 19. The word VAST means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Vast means enormous.

questions.prompt: 20. The word GLEAM means most nearly —
questions.feedback: To gleam is to shine with a soft light.

questions.prompt: 21. The word JAGGED means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Jagged means having sharp, uneven points or edges.

questions.prompt: 22. The word MEAGER means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Meager means scarce — too small in amount.

questions.prompt: 23. The word STURDY means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Sturdy means strong and solidly built.

questions.prompt: 24. The word TIMID means most nearly —
questions.feedback: Timid means shy and easily frightened.
